name: ozymandosis
description: A real-time strategy game of bioluminescent evolution.

scripts.test:ui: node test/ui.smoke.cjs && node test/touch.test.cjs && node test/flow.test.cjs && node test/features.test.cjs && node test/mp.test.cjs && node test/online.test.cjs
scripts.android:apk: node tools/build-web.cjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:open: node tools/build-web.cjs && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run play:test && npm run test:ui
